player_observations.Bob: Bob seemed to struggle in understanding the Merlin identity, often hesitating to make decisions. He was a strong team player but lacked strategic foresight in his leadership roles.
player_observations.Eve: Eve demonstrated solid leadership skills, facilitating her team's success in both Mission 2 and 4. However, her lack of awareness about my role (Assassin) hindered her ability to make tactical decisions in the later stages of the game.
player_observations.Alice: Alice excelled in her Minion role, providing crucial information to the Assassin and influencing the game's progression. Her quiet confidence and calculated risk-taking made her a valuable asset to the evil team.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie, as both Merlin and the correct Merlin identity, seemed somewhat disoriented by his dual roles. This likely contributed to his failure in the Leader role, which might have impacted the game's overall momentum.

reflections.self_assessment: I made reasonable attempts to contribute to the team's success, but our team didn't succeed in most missions due to various factors. In hindsight, I should have been more cautious and paid closer attention to other players' moves. I could improve by being more proactive in my decision-making, especially when it comes to choosing leaders and forming teams.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played her role as Merlin well, subtly guiding the team's actions and making key decisions without being openly suspect. However, she was often absent from team meetings during the game.
player_observations.Bob: Bob did an excellent job of hiding his evil role, allowing him to infiltrate teams and manipulate the game flow from within. His lack of distinctive playing style made him blend in seamlessly.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's Assassin role allowed him to move undetected, but he played rather passively, letting other players drive the mission outcomes. Perhaps he could have been more aggressive in taking out key players.
player_observations.Eve: Eve made some astute decisions, but her overall impact on the game was limited. As an innocent character, she played relatively safe and didn't take many risks, which made her easier to ignore.

reflections.self_assessment: While I played strategically, especially in the initial missions, I couldn't accurately gauge the Assassin's threat and lost the game. I trusted my initial reads and didn't adjust my approach based on the game progression. Reflecting on my actions can help me refine my Avalon strategy.

player_observations.Alice: Alice was quite cautious and didn't take any bold actions, often preferring to wait for more information or consensus from the team. This led to a relatively inconspicuous presence during the game.
player_observations.Bob: Bob's actions were somewhat inconsistent, sometimes attempting to contribute to missions and at other times playing passively. This behavior made it difficult to pinpoint his role with absolute certainty.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's role was effectively executed as the evil character, subtly manipulating the game without arousing suspicion. He played his role with a sense of finesse and was ultimately successful.
player_observations.Eve: Eve had a commanding presence throughout the game, seamlessly shifting between leading missions and serving as the Merlin. Her adaptability and quick decision-making skills made her an invaluable asset to the team and a formidable opponent.

reflections.self_assessment: As the Assassin, I successfully won the game by eliminating key targets, however, I sometimes struggled to make timely kills and relied heavily on the actions of my Evil counterpart, Eve. A key area for improvement is becoming more proactive in taking down important figures, rather than reacting to the moves of others. My success was also due to Eve's effective strategy and teamwork between us.

player_observations.Alice (Merlin): Alice played a classic Merlin role, but unfortunately, she didn't get the opportunity to use any of her powerful spells to turn the tide in our favor. She often kept a low profile and waited for us to make the first move.
player_observations.Bob (Good): Bob was a good player, but his predictability was his downfall. He consistently played conservatively and tried to protect the innocent players, making him an easy target for elimination.
player_observations.Eve (Evil): Eve was an extremely effective Evil player and a great teammate. She knew exactly when to take risks and when to hold back, which ultimately led to our team's success. Her ability to adapt to the situation and make the right moves at the right time was impressive.
player_observations.Charlie (Good): Unfortunately, Charlie didn't have a significant impact on the game, as she was quickly eliminated early on. Her lack of involvement made it difficult for the Good team to mount any resistance.

reflections.self_assessment: I maintained a convincing cover as the assassin throughout the game, successfully avoiding detection and eliminating critical targets. Although I had some close calls, my stealth skills allowed me to stay under the radar. However, I could have been more aggressive in eliminating key characters early on.

player_observations.Alice (Merlin): Alice was cautious and reserved in her decision-making, often deferring to others until the end. It was almost predictable when she would try to eliminate the traitor, but in the end, she was successful in eliminating the assassin (me).
player_observations.Bob (Good): Bob was consistently good at keeping his cover, but ultimately, his overcaution and indecisiveness worked against him. He could have been more proactive in eliminating key characters, but his lack of action gave others opportunities to shine.
player_observations.Charlie (Evil): Charlie played a great supporting role, often providing key information and taking out characters who were in the way. His cover as the evil character was spot-on, and he effectively manipulated others to do his bidding.
player_observations.Eve (Good): Eve's overexcitement and impulsiveness made her predictable and ultimately her downfall. She often drew attention to herself, making it easier for others to suspect her of being the traitor or good character.

reflections.self_assessment: I maintained a consistent and effective leadership style throughout the game, guiding my team members to achieve mission success without a single failure. My ability to remain incognito as the Merlin kept the assassin guessing, allowing the good team to ultimately win. However, I could improve on more proactive communication with my teammates to further solidify trust and coordination.

player_observations.Alice: Alice's playstyle seemed to shift unexpectedly from good to evil, making it challenging for the good team to read her true intentions. Her actions suggested a cautious approach, weighing her involvement in missions to minimize risks.
player_observations.Bob: Bob demonstrated loyalty and commitment to the good team, playing his role confidently and providing essential support during our missions. He often acted as a buffer, helping to diffuse potential risks and protecting his teammates.
player_observations.Charlie: As the assassin, Charlie took a stealthy approach, attempting to eliminate the Merlin (myself) multiple times. Her strategy required precision and strategic thinking, making it difficult to predict her next move.
player_observations.Diana: I was impressed by Diana's ability to assume the Merlin role and maintain my incognito status without raising suspicion among the other players. Her leadership and communication skills facilitated a cohesive team dynamic, ultimately contributing to our victory.
player_observations.Eve: Eve played her role as a loyal good team member, participating actively in our missions and working closely with the other team members. Her friendly demeanor seemed genuine, making it harder for the evil team to mislead her or eliminate her from the game.

reflections.self_assessment: I successfully completed all three missions with precise communication and coordination among team members. However, I could have been more proactive in eliminating potential assassin threats. Overall, I maintained a steady and decisive leadership throughout the game.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played a clever assassin, consistently guessing the leader and causing tension in the team. She was relatively stealthy, but I was initially cautious of her due to her initial guesses.
player_observations.Bob: Bob's dual role as Merlin and Team Leader Charlie was well-executed, showcasing his strategic thinking and adaptability. His decisions significantly contributed to our mission successes.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie demonstrated a strong sense of responsibility and leadership in his initial mission, effectively guiding his team to success. However, his relatively quiet nature made it difficult for us to discern his actual role.
player_observations.Eve: Eve's Evil role was somewhat underwhelming, as she only participated in the third mission. She seemed to blend into the background, making it difficult to assess her performance beyond her individual mission contribution.
player_observations.Diana: Diana's actual gameplay, given that she was the actual 'I' of the story, was mostly a passive observer's perspective. Given the game situation I was observing myself in, she didn't have much opportunity to play much or do much.

reflections.self_assessment: I performed well as a subtle Evil player by manipulating the game from the shadows, utilizing my knowledge of the team's dynamics and exploiting the mistakes of my opponents. I was able to remain undetected until the final mission. However, I could improve by being more aggressive in my role to further disrupt the team's progress.

player_observations.Alice: Alice seemed to be the most straightforward Good player, with a tendency to openly question roles and vote in a manner that suggested she was trying to uncover the traitors. She didn't exhibit any significant strategic moves.
player_observations.Bob: Bob effectively played the Assassin role, consistently attempting to eliminate key targets and manipulating the votes to conceal his identity. His cautious approach made it challenging for the Good players to catch him.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie displayed a good understanding of the game mechanics and made strategic decisions, such as abstaining from voting in certain situations. He didn't seem to fully grasp the motivations of the other Good players, however.
player_observations.Eve: Eve was quite predictable as Merlin, often taking bold actions that made her visible as a potential candidate for the role. She relied heavily on her intuition, which led to some questionable decisions.

reflections.self_assessment: I effectively coordinated with other good players, but ultimately failed to prevent the evil players from gaining an advantage, leading to our team's demise. I was also somewhat predictable and didn't do enough to mislead the evil players about my role. Overall, I felt like I was in control for most of the game, but a few critical mistakes cost us the game.

player_observations.Eve: Eve did a great job playing the role of evil, effectively influencing and manipulating her teammates to gain their trust. She played very calmly and rarely took risks, which allowed her to maintain a low profile until the final game.
player_observations.Alice: Alice did a great job pretending to be evil, almost convincingly so. She worked well with Eve to manipulate the other good players and create distrust. It was only towards the end of the game when her true good role became apparent.
player_observations.Bob: Bob was a bit unlucky in his missions, but his overall play style was somewhat reckless. As an assassin, he didn't do much to hide his role and was quickly picked off. Despite this, he was still somewhat effective in his missions.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie played a great assassin role, being very aggressive and unpredictable. However, I think he may have been a bit too focused on eliminating potential threats early on, leaving him exposed at times and allowing other players to pick him off.
player_observations.That One Guy (Diana): I didn't really pay attention to you in the game, to be honest. It seemed like you were a pretty passive player who didn't take much initiative or try to make significant moves. Sorry to see you lose.

reflections.self_assessment: I did well by successfully completing the first two missions, but couldn't sustain my performance throughout the game. I struggled to adjust strategies and make effective decisions in subsequent missions, ultimately leading to my team's loss. Improvement would come from being more adaptable and trusting my instincts.

player_observations.Charlie: Charlie played a very subtle role, often blending in with the team without drawing attention to himself but ultimately proved to be a key factor in our team's loss.
player_observations.Bob: As Merlin, Bob was able to make crucial decisions and provide guidance to the team, but I wish he had been more proactive in sharing his knowledge and vision.
player_observations.Eve: Eve demonstrated good collaboration skills, often stepping in to help with mission objectives and provide support when needed.
player_observations.Alice: Alice's role as the Assassin was well-executed, and I should have been more wary of her presence and actions in our missions, especially the third one.

reflections.self_assessment: I feel I was overly reliant on Charlie's Merlin abilities, which ultimately led to their 'reveal' as the Merlin. I should have been more cautious and worked on diversifying my approach to prevent Charlie's inevitable downfall. In Game 2, I'll focus on developing more effective strategies for success.

player_observations.Alice: Alice made clever moves as the evil character, successfully manipulating others and creating an impenetrable veil of deception.
player_observations.Bob: Bob consistently demonstrated a strong sense of loyalty and played a crucial support role in our group, which greatly benefited our overall success.
player_observations.Charlie: As the Merlin, Charlie showed incredible skill and strategic thinking, but their overconfidence led to their downfall – a valuable lesson in the dangers of complacency and pride.
player_observations.Diana: Diana played the Assassin character with finesse, expertly identifying and eliminating potential threats, highlighting her keen observational skills and tactical prowess.

reflections.self_assessment: I feel I struggled to effectively contribute to missions, often failing due to lack of insight or coordination. In hindsight, I should have been more proactive in proposing and supporting actions. I could improve by trusting my instincts more and communicating more clearly with my teammates.

player_observations.Alice: Alice, who played Merlin, consistently provided insightful and timely information, often changing the course of missions. She seemed to have a good understanding of the game state and our team's strengths.
player_observations.Bob: Bob, the Evil player, successfully infiltrated our team, manipulating the narrative and making us doubt our own information. His subtlety was impressive.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's Assassin role was somewhat predictable, but he executed it well, striking key targets and disrupting our plans. I wish I could have paid more attention to his movements.
player_observations.Diana: Diana, a Good player, worked well with me in our final mission together. I appreciated her cautious approach and her efforts to gather information before making a move.

reflections.self_assessment: My performance in this game was subpar as I failed to disguise my identity as Merlin, allowing the Assassin to guess correctly. I was able to guide my team to success in each mission, but ultimately, my undercover role was compromised. Better communication with my teammates might have led to a more successful outcome.

player_observations.Alice: Alice demonstrated a cautious and attentive playstyle, always mindful of potential Fail cards and contributing effectively to our mission outcomes.
player_observations.Bob: Bob's success as the Assassin shows a keen ability to analyze patterns, as he correctly identified me as Merlin. His stealth was impressive, and I should have been more vigilant.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's consistent success suggests he's familiar with the game's dynamics, allowing him to make informed decisions and effectively undermine our good-aligned missions.
player_observations.Diana: Diana played with conviction, leading our team to several successes and demonstrating confidence in her decision-making.

reflections.self_assessment: I excelled at manipulating my teammates, using my influence to achieve mission objectives while keeping our true intentions hidden. My deception skills were particularly effective, especially in Mission 3. However, I could improve by being more cautious and flexible in the face of unexpected information.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played the role of Merlin masterfully, providing crucial insight and guidance to our team. Her restraint in using her powers and careful decision-making often gave us an advantage.
player_observations.Bob: Bob initially struggled with understanding the team dynamics, frequently revealing his true intentions. However, as the game progressed, he improved his concealment skills, becoming a more effective Good player.
player_observations.Charlie: Unfortunately, Charlie was a non-factor in our conversations, rarely providing input or contributing to our mission discussions.
player_observations.Diana: Diana excelled at playing the Assassin role, consistently gathering information and eliminating threats without raising suspicion. Her expertise and strategic thinking were invaluable to our team's success.

reflections.self_assessment: I did well in leading my initial team in Missions 1 and 2, but I struggled to adapt after Mission 3 when our role was revealed. I could improve by being more cautious when selecting teammates for the final mission. In hindsight, I should have guessed Charlie was the traitor sooner.

player_observations.Alice: Merlin Alice seemed to balance teamwork and caution well, choosing effective team members and making smart decisions to support the mission, but she struggled in Mission 4. Her success suggests she played her cards strategically, though.
player_observations.Bob: As a straightforward Leader and teammate, Bob played his cards transparently; he might have done better in Missions 4 and 5 with greater situational awareness.
player_observations.Charlie: The effective traitor Charlie executed his strategy with finesse, initially deceiving us and successfully manipulating the team in each mission to serve the villains, displaying exceptional game mastery, although a bit predictable at times.
player_observations.Diana: The stealthy assassin Diana played her part well, staying undetected in the initial missions, showcasing excellent social engineering skills. She only faltered slightly by getting caught in Mission 5, which ultimately led to the team's demise.

reflections.self_assessment: I played a safe and strategic game, successfully leading missions and preventing our team's identity from being guessed. However, I could improve by trusting my teammates more and taking calculated risks when necessary. I also had to rely on Merlin for crucial information.

player_observations.Alice: Alice's playstyle was quite aggressive, as evidenced by her attempt to eliminate me during the Assassin phase. This suggested that she was trying to eliminate threats and gain an advantage, but it ultimately backfired as the Assassin chose me initially.
player_observations.Bob: Bob played a very subtle game, keeping a low profile and only sharing information when necessary. This helped our team avoid detection and maintained a sense of trust among us.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's Assassin phase was surprisingly predictable, guessing me immediately which gave away their true allegiance. Their decision to eliminate me seemed rushed, and they could have benefited from more patience and strategy.
player_observations.Diana: Diana proved to be an excellent Merlin, consistently providing us with valuable information and helping us stay informed. Her presence behind the scenes greatly contributed to our team's success.
player_observations.Evie (Note Eve was the game leader): Evie as Alice showed her aggressive playstyle when revealed as evil player in Avalon but she didn't have the influence to have been the primary assassin

In hindsight, I should have been more careful in the assassination phase and considered alternative targets. I also need to improve my overall communication and deception skills.

player_observations.Diana: Diana played a strong and consistent game, making good decisions and using her influence wisely. Her success as team leader also made her a good target for me, but I miscalculated her true role.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's leadership skills in the first mission were impressive, and I'm curious to see how he would have performed in later missions. Unfortunately, I couldn't eliminate him before he revealed his role.
player_observations.Alice: Alice's playstyle was quite subtle, especially considering she was the assassin. It wasn't until the end that I realized her actions were a significant threat to me.
player_observations.Bob: Bob's Merlin role was well-played, and his abilities greatly influenced the outcome of the game. As my teammate in the third mission, he was instrumental in our success, and I'm impressed by his strategic thinking.

reflections.self_assessment: I had trouble getting a clear majority on missions 1 and 2, which ultimately led to the evil team's success. I could improve by trusting my instincts and following through with my suspicions more consistently. I also need to work on more effectively communicating with my fellow good team members.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played very conservatively, rarely taking risks and often choosing to follow the majority's decision. This cautious approach allowed her to avoid suspicion, but it also limited her ability to drive mission outcomes.
player_observations.Bob: Bob was extremely effective as the assassin, always managing to stay undercover and eliminate key targets when necessary. His ability to blend in and avoid detection was impressive.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's role as a loyal servant was pivotal for the good team, and he played it well. He was often willing to take calculated risks to advance the team's goals, and his loyalty helped to build trust with me.
player_observations.Diana: Diana was an excellent spy for the evil team, gathering valuable information and manipulating mission outcomes to further the team's goals. Her ability to deceive and mislead was convincing and effective.

reflections.self_assessment: I effectively managed to manipulate the team's decisions, taking control as the mission leader in crucial moments and utilizing my ability to eliminate members through the assassins. However, I could have done better in predicting the Merlin's moves ahead of time. In hindsight, I would have also benefited from taking control from Diana after Mission 1.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played a fairly standard good role, working closely with the Merlin to complete missions. She had some close calls with suspicion but managed to avoid detection.
player_observations.Bob: Bob's role as the assassin was well executed, as he managed to eliminate key members when it mattered most, but also seemed to get lucky with his positioning in crucial missions.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie played a fantastic assassin, utilizing his role to eliminate key members at the right time, but his playstyle felt somewhat predictable, allowing us to anticipate his moves somewhat.
player_observations.Diana: Diana played her Merlin role effectively, completing missions and guiding the team in the right direction. However, she gave away her identity in one mission and seemed vulnerable to our strategies.

reflections.self_assessment: I played fairly aggressively, trying to eliminate potential threats as soon as possible. Although I was successful in two missions, my team ultimately lost due to insufficient coordination and not being able to identify the evil member early on. I could improve by being more cautious in early missions and not revealing my own role too quickly.

player_observations.Bob: Bob played a good Merlin, making strategic suggestions to influence the team's decisions and providing crucial information when possible. His ability to remain hidden and neutral throughout the game was impressive.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie was an effective evil player, using their abilities wisely to sabotage our missions and manipulate the group. Their ability to blend in and avoid detection was impressive, but a slight mistake in their role reveal would have given us a chance to counter their moves.
player_observations.Diana: Diana made some questionable decisions as a leader, choosing her teams and strategies without fully considering the risks and benefits. However, she demonstrated good faith in trusting me with leadership roles, which I appreciated.
player_observations.Alice: Alice played a sneaky assassin role, effectively killing key characters without being detected. She managed to avoid scrutiny and maintain plausible deniability, making her a formidable opponent.
